convert_cityscapes_to_coco: convert a cityscapes category ID to its corresponding COCO category ID using the standard mapping
convert_cityscapes_to_coco_with_rider: convert a cityscapes category ID to COCO treating rider as person instead of random initialization
convert_cityscapes_to_coco_without_perso: convert a cityscapes category ID to COCO ignoring both person and rider categories
convert_cityscapes_to_coco_all_random: convert all cityscapes category IDs to -1 for random initialization across all categories
review_category_mapping: review the COCO to Cityscapes category ID mapping lookup tables and their differences
